items.question: Do joint pains always require surgery?
items.answer: No. Many joint and bone conditions can be treated with medication, physiotherapy, and lifestyle changes.

items.question: How long does recovery take after surgery?
items.answer: Recovery depends on the procedure, but our team provides complete rehabilitation support for faster recovery.
